The '''2008 Tippeligaen''' was the 64th completed season of top division [[association football|football]] in [[Norway]]. The season began on 29 March and ended 2 November.<ref>{{cite web | title = Tippeligaen - Fixtures 2008 | work=NRK Sport | url=http://www.nrksport.no/fotball/eliteserien/?arr=l1&sesong=2008&type=terminliste | access-date=2008-04-05| archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20080417093542/http://nrksport.no/fotball/eliteserien/?arr=l1&sesong=2008&type=terminliste| archive-date= 17 April 2008 | url-status= live}}</ref> [[SK Brann|Brann]] were the defending champions, having won their third [[Tippeligaen]] championship in 2007. The teams promoted from the [[1. divisjon]] at the end of the previous season were champions [[Molde FK|Molde]], automatic qualifiers [[HamKam]], and play-off winners [[FK Bodø/Glimt|Bodø/Glimt]].

==Overview==
===Summary===
[[Stabæk Fotball|Stabæk]] secured their first ever league championship by defeating [[Vålerenga Fotball|Vålerenga]] 6–2 in the penultimate round. From the [[2009 Tippeligaen|2009 season]] onwards, the number of teams in the Tippeligaen was expanded from fourteen to sixteen.<ref>{{cite web|title=Tippeligaen utvides til 16 lag |work=Football Association of Norway |url=http://www.fotball.no/table.asp?p=53184&cat=51834&x=1&a=221127 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20080804140606/http://www.fotball.no/table.asp?p=53184&cat=51834&x=1&a=221127 |url-status=dead |archive-date=2008-08-04 |access-date=2008-03-09 |date=2008-03-08 |language=no }}</ref> To accommodate this expansion, only one team faced automatic relegation to the 1. divisjon, as opposed to the regular two, while the three best teams in the 1. divisjon were awarded automatic promotion. As in previous years, there was a two-legged playoff at the end of the season, this time between the thirteenth-placed team in the Tippeligaen and the fourth best team in the 1. divisjon.

==Relegation play-offs==
By finishing 13th, [[Aalesunds FK|Aalesund]] competed in a two-legged relegation play-off against [[Sogndal Fotball|Sogndal]], who finished 4th in the [[2008 1. divisjon]], for the right to play in the [[2009 Tippeligaen]]. Sogndal played at home first, decided in a draw held by the [[Football Association of Norway|NFF]].<ref>{{cite news| title=Trekning kvalifiseringskamp| url=http://www.fotball.no/table.asp?p=53184&cat=51834&x=1&a=235823| work=fotball.no| date=2008-10-08| access-date=2008-11-03}}</ref> Aalesund won 7–2 on aggregate, thereby securing a new season in the [[Tippeligaen]]. Sogndal remained in the [[1. divisjon]].
